title: DigitalHumanities MuseumProvenanceMerge

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the Museum Provenance Merge research task. Consolidated and deduplicated museum export datasets from 70 records to 24 unique objects. Extracted temporal information from object notes, achieving 95.8% year coverage. Generated comprehensive analysis including temporal distribution visualizations and a detailed research report. All deliverables (code, outputs, report with figures) are complete and saved in the workspace.
